title.narrative: Strengthening Civil Society through Universal Periodic Review

description.narrative: The ‘Strengthening Civil Society through the Universal Periodic Review’ project aims to strengthen the capacity of Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) and National Human Rights Institutions (NHRIs) to effectively advocate for human rights and democratic reform through the Universal Periodic Review. The objective to ensure that marginalised, and at-risk communities, in particular from least developed countries have access to, and influence in the national human rights decision-making process. The project will also seek to effectively involve children in the UPR in order to contribute to their empowerment as active and responsible citizens. The key activities include organising Pre-sessions to the UPR annually; providing financial support for civil society representatives to travel to Geneva for the Pre-sessions; and hosting UPR training workshops annually for CSOs and NHRIs, including a specific training for grant recipients and child participants.
